#Drop empty year entries and reassign dataypes
df = df.dropna(subset=['Year'])
df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype('int64')
object_col = df.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns
df[object_col] = df[object_col].astype('string')

#Round float data types to 2 decimal places
float_col = df.select_dtypes(include=['float64']).columns
df[float_col] = df[float_col].round(2)

#Machine learning models setup
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, KFold, cross_val_score, cross_val_predict, cross_validate
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor, GradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, r2_score, mean_absolute_error
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsRegressor
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPRegressor
from sklearn.svm import SVR
import time

#Select factor and target variables
X = df[["Platform", "Genre", "Review", "Year"]]
y = df["Global"]

#Convert categorical into dummy numerical variables
#split the data set into 80/20 and fix at random state of 67
X_encoded = pd.get_dummies(X, columns=["Platform", "Genre"], drop_first=True)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X_encoded, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=67)

#Scales the data based on the testing data input
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train = scaler.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test = scaler.transform(X_test)
In [12]:
#Random Forest Machine Learning Model
model = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=67)

#Trains the current machine learning model using the training data and creates predictions using the model
#Also measures time taken to train the model and time taken to make prediction
start_train = time.time()
model.fit(X_train, y_train)
end_train = time.time()
training_time = end_train - start_train

start_pred = time.time()
y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
end_pred = time.time()
prediction_time = end_pred - start_pred

#Calculates coefficient of determination, root mean squared error, and mean absolute error
r2 = r2_score(y_test, y_pred)
rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred))
mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, y_pred)

#Results of the current machine learning model
print("R²:", r2)
print("RMSE:", rmse)
print("MAE:", mae)
print("Training Time:", training_time)
print("Prediction Time:", prediction_time)

#5-fold cross validation

#Splits the data set into 5 random equal parts
cv = KFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=67)

#Models
models = {
    "Random Forest": RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=67),
    "Gradient Boosting": GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=200, random_state=67),
    "KNN": KNeighborsRegressor(n_neighbors=10),
    "ANN": MLPRegressor(hidden_layer_sizes=(100,50), max_iter=500, random_state=67),
    "SVR": SVR(kernel="rbf")
}

scoring = {
    "r2": "r2",
    "rmse": "neg_root_mean_squared_error",
    "mae": "neg_mean_absolute_error"
}

#Calculate and print average values for the 5-fold cross validation
for name, model in models.items():

    #Scales the data for each machine learning model
    pipeline = Pipeline([("scaler", StandardScaler()),("model", model)])
    
    start_time = time.time()
    
    #Calculates the average coefficient of determination, root mean squared error, and mean absolute error for each machine learning model
    scores = cross_validate(pipeline,X_encoded,y,cv=cv,scoring=scoring)
    
    end_time = time.time()
    total_time = end_time - start_time
    
    r2 = scores["test_r2"].mean()
    rmse = abs(scores["test_rmse"].mean())
    mae = abs(scores["test_mae"].mean())
    
    #Prints the results for each machine learning model
    print(name)
    print("R²:", r2)
    print("RMSE:", rmse)
    print("MAE:", mae)
    print("Cross-Validation Time:", total_time)
    print()
